audit.whatIsWrong: The lane was described as generic poke with a root, without the sequencing that actually makes it dangerous.
audit.why: Spell Flux is on a 2.5-to-3.5 second cooldown and Rune Prison only ROOTS if Flux is already on you — untouched by Flux it is a slow. Every other basic ability also resets Overload.
audit.corrected: Hard at 8/10 because Spell Flux comes back every 3 seconds and turns the next Rune Prison from a slow into a root.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer gave Ryze all seven stages while the content layer and the packet chart both give Kassadin the last three.
audit.why: Realm Warp adds no duel power at 6, and Kassadin's mana scaling passes Ryze once items land. The full-layer whys for rows 4, 5 and 6 already describe Kassadin winning — only the side tokens were wrong.
audit.corrected: phases[4], [5] and [6] set to Kassadin, matching win[4..6] and the existing whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent: Rune Prison only roots when Flux is on the target, and it cancels Null Sphere's channel.
audit.why: Riot's text for Rune Prison states it slows, and 'if the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted'. Null Sphere is a channel that any CC ends.
audit.corrected: Clean of Flux, his W is only a slow — the root needs Spell Flux first, so the E landing on you is the real warning. And never start Null Sphere while Rune Prison is available: the cage cancels the cast.

audit.why: Rune Prison 11/10.5/10/9.5/9, Spell Flux 3.5 down to 2.5, Overload a flat 5 but reset by every other cast, Realm Warp 180/160/140.
audit.corrected: Numbers written in, with Rune Prison named as the one gate that matters.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing stated the structural reason the late game is yours.
audit.why: Ryze has no dash and no blink in his kit — his only repositioning is a 3000-range Realm Warp with a delay on a 140-second cooldown.
audit.corrected: Once Rune Prison is spent he has no way to leave, and Riftwalk repeats every 2 seconds.

audit.why: 50.88% across 792 games is a genuine coin-flip that swings on whether the lane is survived.
